$comment: users.history.list -> GET gmail/v1/users/{userId}/history. Read from Google's reference 2026-11-04 and -07: startHistoryId REQUIRED; maxResults defaults to 100, max 500; 'Supplying an invalid or out of date startHistoryId typically returns an HTTP 404'; 'If you receive no nextPageToken in the response, there are no updates to retrieve and you can store the returned historyId'. Messages in a record 'will typically only have id and threadId'. Accepts gmail.readonly.
title: List Gmail mailbox history
description: List what changed in a mailbox since a history id: messages added or deleted, labels added or removed.

config.label: Mailbox
config.description: `me` is the connected account and is almost always what you want.

config.label: Start history id
config.description: Changes AFTER this id. Take it from a watch, a message, or a previous list's historyId. Out of Gmail's range (typically older than a week) it answers 404.

config.label: Only this kind of change
config.description: Blank: every kind. messageAdded is new mail (and sent mail and drafts, unless a label narrows it).

config.label: Only this label
config.description: Only messages with this label, e.g. INBOX for received mail.

outputShape.description: History records, oldest first. Each has an id and messagesAdded / messagesDeleted / labelsAdded / labelsRemoved; a message there carries only id and threadId: read its content with message_get.
The mailbox's CURRENT history id. Store it as the next start ONLY when there is no nextPageToken.
Present when there is another page.
Which estate this ran against. Google has no sandbox, so: fake or live.
